name: Crystal Dream II ~Maou no Gen'ei~
original_name: クリスタルドリーム Ⅱ ～魔王の幻影～
source:
Hero is a brave person who is worried that the town stays under tyrannical rule. He sets to talk to magistrate, but on the way there hears a story that demon was revived and town magistrate being manipulated. So he forwards to Crystal castle to defeat demon king.

[From [url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/05/vn-of-year-1990.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名勇敢的青年，一直为城镇遭受暴政统治而忧心。他动身去找地方长官交涉，却在途中听说魔王已经复活，长官也遭到了操控。于是，他转而前往水晶城，准备击败魔王。

[引自[url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/05/vn-of-year-1990.html]vndbreview[/url]]
